rationale: ARAD is the canonical CNB time-series database behind every CZ payment/card/ATM/POS figure.
Static REST API spec PDF: read once to build the ARAD collector, not a recurring signal producer.
Semi-annual payment-statistics commentary with cards, ATMs and POS terminal counts; the headline recurring release.
Hub page under cnb.cz statistics whose data tables are already reached via ARAD and the payment-statistics commentary.
Distinct banking-sector aggregate release giving the denominator context for payment penetration and market sizing.
CERTIS monthly/annual volumes are the highest-frequency hard indicator of CZ payment activity.
Static CERTIS system description sitting above the statistics page already monitored; methodology context only.
Instant-payments volumes plus a versioned participant list: a recurring actor map for the fastest-moving CZ payment segment.
Currency-in-circulation and denomination data is the core cash-usage series against card/instant substitution.
Reporting framework page defines the payment-statistics fields and changes with each regulatory amendment; needed for series comparability.
SDAT methodology catalogue is mined once to map the full payment/fraud/terminal field inventory behind the aggregates.
Single 2024 annual-report PDF; useful evidence but the index page, not this file, is what recurs.
One Financial Stability Report vintage PDF; background context on bank capacity rather than a payment data feed.
Annual supervision report index tracking licensed payment and e-money institutions: recurring market entry/exit signal.
Statutory register of CZ banks, payment and e-money institutions; the definitive continuously-updated actor map.
CNB open-data catalogue gives the legally-sanctioned machine-readable feeds of the entity lists.
Reporting-population lists mined once to know which institutions sit inside each statistical aggregate.
Statistics portal root is the parent index for discovery of new CNB statistical domains; worth monitoring for structure changes.
Release calendar entry lets payment-statistics pulls be scheduled to actual publication dates.
CNB press-release feed surfaces headline payment/cash figures and methodology changes ahead of series refresh.
Central-bank staff blog interpreting cash vs card substitution; commentary stream, low but genuine standalone value.
Plain-language CNB mirror duplicating monitored pages and currently unverified; recheck liveness before spending a slot.
ECB PAY dataset is the harmonised machine-readable backbone for CZ card, POS and ATM benchmarking.
Legacy PSS series carries the pre-2022 long history of CZ terminal and payment-service data.
Category index mined once to extract the exact POS/ATM series keys, then superseded by the PAY dataset itself.
A single H1-2025 press release; the release series is better tracked via the ECB payments-statistics calendar.
Localised ECB org page with no data; only terminology value, redundant with the ECB Data Portal entries.
EBA press-release hub delivering the annual joint payment-fraud report with CZ country breakdowns by instrument.
